summary: Expand the experience from a single-page romantic Chocolate Day interaction to a multi-page flow with additional sweet/romantic messages and a virtual “box full of chocolates” gifting element.
architectural_notes: Scope change: move from single-page experience to a multi-page flow to present additional messages and gifting content.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Illustration of an elegant closed gift box for chocolates, romantic color palette (chocolate-gift-box-closed.dim_1200x800.png)
- Illustration/top-view of an open gift box filled with assorted chocolates (chocolate-gift-box-open.dim_1200x800.png)
- Seamless pattern background of small hearts and cocoa elements, warm tones (chocolate-pattern-bg.dim_1600x900.png)

existing_features.title: Create a single-page Chocolate Day experience that feels unique, romantic, colorful, and professionally designed, centered around the recipient’s favorite chocolate: “Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut”.

Add a clickable chocolate gallery (card/grid layout) that includes at minimum one item labeled “Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut” plus additional chocolate options; clicking any chocolate image reveals a romantic text message for that specific chocolate.

Implement a romantic ‘reveal’ interaction that feels special (e.g., animated modal with soft transitions, confetti/hearts accent, or elegant flip-card reveal) while keeping the UI accessible (keyboard operable, readable contrast, focus states).

Add a cohesive visual theme for the entire page (colors, typography, spacing, background treatment) aligned to a romantic, colorful aesthetic (avoid blue/purple-dominant palettes) and apply it consistently across all components.
Add the required generated images as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the chocolate gallery (no backend image serving).
Update the chocolate gallery data to include only one chocolate option: “Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut”, and remove the other chocolate options from the interactive experience.
Adjust user-facing copy in the page and gallery to reflect that there is only one favorite chocolate (singular phrasing), without referencing multiple chocolates or a “collection”.
Update the gallery layout so the single chocolate card is presented in a visually balanced way (e.g., centered on larger screens) rather than leaving an empty multi-column grid.

Convert the current single-page Chocolate Day experience into a simple multi-page (multi-step) flow within the frontend, with clear Next/Back navigation and a visible progress indicator, while keeping the existing Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut reveal interaction available in the flow.

Add additional romantic/sweet message content across the subsequent pages that praises the recipient (e.g., how sweet he is), using English user-facing text and keeping the tone romantic and heartfelt.

Add a “virtual chocolates” gifting experience as a dedicated page/step featuring a visually rich ‘box full of chocolates’ view (open box with assorted chocolates), including a small romantic note for him.
Integrate the required new static image assets for the virtual chocolate box experience under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the new gifting step/page (no backend image serving).

new_feature_requests.summary: Build a romantic Chocolate Day interactive page/app with colorful professional design, showing chocolate images (including Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut) that reveal text/messages when clicked.
Restrict the chocolate selection to only “Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut” (no additional chocolate options in the gallery).
Add additional romantic/sweet messages across subsequent pages (multi-page flow) praising the recipient (e.g., how sweet he is).
Add a virtual chocolates gifting experience, such as a “box full of chocolates” view/interaction for him.

projectName: Romantic Chocolate Day interactive page with clickable chocolate images and love notes
